legs.detail: scripts/build-estate-archive.py regeneration: every distribution's resolved bytes re-hash to its signed digest and byte size; the set is packaged as a BagIt 1.0 bag (RFC 8493) and the bag validates with full checksum verification (bagit.py reference implementation). Payload-Oxum 125430624.486.

Both deposits' single archive files (the GitHub release source zips) MD5-match the checksums Zenodo serves for the records. Contents verified per file against each release's own signed index (inside the zip) and against the current signed index: unchanged files read verified, moved files read superseded, divergences are logged as exceptions. v1.2.0 record 23844324 (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23818766); v1.1.0 record 23818767.

Sampled captures fetched in id_ identity form: every sampled capture's bytes re-hash (SHA-1, Wayback digest form) to its CDX digest — the captures are the indexed bytes, unaltered. Every sampled capture differs from the current seal: classification source-changed (the live site, GitHub and the local bag agree on the current bytes; the captures hold the pre-Solution-A / pre-reseal generation). Zero snapshot-altered, zero corruption.

All 43 registry targets re-queried against the live CDX index this run: 37 recorded captures verified present with digest/status/length; 5 recorded captures not verifiable by any method (see exceptions); both Zenodo record pages confirmed to hold no Wayback capture (record 23818767: six Save Page Now attempts failed with HTTP 520 in 2026-10-30/31; preservation is by DOI).
